receipt.public_excerpt: AIW reveals severe reasoning deficits in SOTA LLMs.

evidence_items.explanation: Repeated tests of a simple family-relation problem found very low success for many models and large fluctuations under small variations. GPT-4 and Claude 3 Opus performed better than most models, so the result supports recurring failures rather than universal inability.

receipt.public_excerpt: unlikely to achieve high OOD robustness

evidence_items.explanation: The benchmark reports extensive vision-model weaknesses under distribution shifts. Its original results predate the selected period, and adversarial robustness is narrower than the full claim, so it supplies context only.

Materials-model evaluations found many successful tasks involving withheld chemistry or symmetry. The paper also links poor results to test inputs outside the represented training domain, showing why unfamiliarity alone does not establish likely failure.
